## Why these files

Each upstream skill is a short prompt specification with a worked example: `latex-tables` carries a complete `booktabs` regression-table skeleton, `econ-visualization` a `ggplot2` figure skeleton. Both are kept as reference material for `skills/tables-figures/`, mainly so that the table and figure code shapes have a citable upstream. The upstream `index.md` files are byte-identical duplicates of the matching `SKILL.md` files, so they are not copied twice. The upstream site assets, Jekyll configuration and its other skills are not vendored.

These files are third-party reference documents, not part of this kit's skill contract. `skills/tables-figures/SKILL.md` is the only procedure that applies in this repository; nothing here is loaded as one of the eight stages.

## Modifications

None. Every file in this directory is byte-identical to the upstream commit above; SHA-256 hashes were compared after copying.
